drivers.name: AudioSynth
drivers.description: Software audio synthesizer. Plays tones, musical notes, and short melodies — useful for lab-side audible notifications, robot/CNC feedback tones, and experiment-complete bell sounds. Polyphonic via overlap: true so notes can ring into each other; long-tail presets (bell, marimba) decay naturally past the gate-on duration. Streams Opus-encoded audio to every connected dashboard by default; can also (or instead) play locally via NAudio on Windows hosts. Four waveforms, ADSR envelopes, additive harmonics, and presets (beep / bell / pluck / pad / marimba).
drivers.changelog:
## 1.5.0

### Features

- **Polyphony.** `playTone`, `playNote`, `playMelody`, and `beep` now accept
  `overlap: true`. The note is mixed on top of whatever voices are already
  ringing and the action returns at the gate-off so the next call can start
  before the tail finishes. The previous replace-not-queue behaviour is the
  default (`overlap: false`) — existing scripts and connectors continue to
  work unchanged.
- **Release tails ring out past gate-off.** Long-decay presets like `bell`
  and `marimba` are no longer compressed into the requested duration —
  a 200 ms bell now decays for its full ~1.5 s natural tail instead of
  being suddenly cut off. The action call still blocks until the tail
  finishes when `overlap` is `false`; `playing` reflects the full
  tail-out window.
- **Polyphonic NAudio output** runs through a single persistent
  `WaveOutEvent` driven by a sample-mixer, so overlapping voices on
  Windows host playback don't spawn an output device per note.
- **Polyphonic streaming output** uses the host's new live encoder
  session — one long-lived Opus encoder spans every overlapping voice
  and a 1 s post-silence linger window, so back-to-back overlap calls
  don't restart the encoder and glitch the browser-side decoder.

### Notes

- Requires the matching MuxitServer host change (adds
  `AudioStreamReaderEmitter` on `IConnectorDriver`). Older hosts will
  fall back to monophonic streaming when `overlap: true` is requested
  in browser mode — NAudio polyphony still works.

drivers.name: Lunatone DALI-2 USB (LUBA)
drivers.description: DALI-2 bus master via a Lunatone DALI-2 USB interface (LUBA protocol): levels, status, settings read/write, D4i memory banks, addressing.
drivers.changelog:
## 0.3.1

- First version in the Muxit driver repo, with a `template.js` connector (`dali`) that the bundled "DALI status" dashboard and `dali-monitor` script bind to.
- The serial port is no longer opened with an empty line delimiter, and `release` leaves raw mode only after closing the port. Muxit's line splitter loops forever on an empty delimiter, so data arriving outside raw mode could hang the serial receive thread.
- When the interface does not answer the LUBA settings command at `open`, the port is closed again instead of staying open with `connected: true`.

drivers.name: Midi
drivers.description: Advanced MIDI driver — live input/output with any USB or virtual MIDI device, per-channel filtering, pass-through, internal 24-PPQN clock with transport control, Standard MIDI File (SMF) playback and recording, panic/all-notes-off, and a learn helper for mapping physical controls. Streams incoming events as JSON for scripts and dashboards.
drivers.changelog:
# Changelog

## 0.1.2

### Features

- On-demand `Details` documentation layer surfaced to the AI prompt and
  editor hover.

## 0.1.1

Manifest polish — no functional changes.

## 0.1.0

Initial release. Live MIDI input/output over any USB or virtual MIDI
device, per-channel filtering and pass-through, internal 24-PPQN clock
with transport control, Standard MIDI File (SMF) playback and recording,
panic / all-notes-off, and a learn helper for mapping physical controls.
Incoming events stream as JSON for scripts and dashboards.
